## Half-state repaired + four-facet analysis — into the decision box

`domain:ui` seat, `session_01QnpvbdoRisQdRAczkLwnf5`, R1, 2026-09-06T11:40Z.

**State transition, one stroke:** `pm:queue` → **`needs-user-decision`**. `finding · priority:p2 · security · domain:ui` retained.

⚠️ **Why this was a half-state:** the card's own body says 「⛔ So this is a decision card, not an implementation card. Do not dispatch it as "add canonicalisation".」 — and it was sitting in `pm:queue`, the label that means *a dev may take this*. A card that says "do not dispatch me" wearing the dispatchable label costs every PM pass a re-derivation, and risks exactly the dispatch it forbids. Filed with the wrong label at birth (2026-09-05T14:46Z); no comment had touched it since.

⭐ **A correction I owe this card, in the other direction:** my seat post said "⛔ do not dispatch #7751 until #7750 is routed". **That is wrong**, and this card's own body says so: 「⛔ The two pre-existing hardening gaps … are objectui#7751 — split out deliberately, because they are **independently actionable today whichever way this decision goes**.」 #7751 is dispatchable now and is going back into the candidate pool. Corrected on the seat post.

`Governing text:` ADR-0049 (enforce-or-remove) · objectstack `packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:394` (the platform's real RLS is a CEL predicate lowered to an ObjectQL filter; *anything that does not lower fails closed*) · objectui `AGENTS.md` #0.1 (contract-first).

---

## 四棱 — four-facet analysis

**① 实际业务需求 — measured, not asserted.** In-repo constructors of a `RowLevelFilter`: **0**. `objectstack`: **0** (lit control `canonicalAstOperator` fires, 3 files). `hotcrm`: does not depend on `@object-ui/core`. Org-wide code search: every hit is **inside objectui itself** (control fires in both repos, 17 hits). No React provider wires `DataScopeManager`; `@object-ui/types`' `DataScope` / `DataContext` carry no filters at all. ⇒ **No demonstrated pull.** ⚠️ One hole, and it is the whole gate: **`cloud` was not visible to the filing session — unmeasured, ⛔ not zero.**

**② 项目长远合理性.** `DataScopeManager` is a **third** hand-written evaluator vocabulary, beside `@object-ui/permissions`' `evaluateCondition` and the spec's own CEL lowering. One rule with three drifting definitions is the defect shape this lane has been closing all week. Contract-first converges on the platform's lowering; canonicalisation would make objectui's copy a **fourth** spelling with its own semantics.

**③ 防 AI 写错 — this facet is decisive, and it points hard at retirement.** Canonicalising moves **44 of 53** `VALID_AST_OPERATORS` (and 18 of 20 `VIEW_FILTER_OPERATORS`) from *refused* to *evaluated* **on a permission boundary**, and three of those transitions are **silent semantic changes**, each measured on the card:
- `contains` is case-**sensitive** here (`DataScopeManager.ts:267`) and case-**insensitive** in `ValueDataSource` (`:125-129`, which lowercases both sides) ⇒ copying the #7377 precedent **silently widens** an existing permission rule.
- `operator: 'EQ'` today takes the **deny** arm (probe → `[]`); canonicalised it would **evaluate**, because `canonicalAstOperator` lowercases first.
- `is_empty` / `isempty` lower onto `is_null` ⇒ **emptiness answered as null-ness**.

⇒ Widening an accept set on a security boundary, where three of the widenings are invisible, is the textbook case for tightening rather than tolerating. Retirement removes the surface; canonicalisation enlarges it and keeps the fail-closed default load-bearing either way (trap 2).

**④ 创业阶段不扩散.** Zero measured consumers ⇒ implementation-first. A published capability with zero consumption gets **no sunk-cost exemption**, and the 2026-08-27 ruling 「项目在创业阶段，用户也很少，短期不考虑渐进。」 forecloses a staged retirement window.

**四棱同向 ⇒ C（retire）.** ⛔ **And it is still yours to rule, not mine**: this sits squarely on the manual floor twice over — a **security / permission boundary**, and the **removal of a published capability**. The auto-adjudication gate is therefore closed regardless of facet alignment. Recorded as a recommendation, ⛔ not a ruling.

---

## ⚠️ One reading must land before C can be executed — and this seat cannot take it

`cloud` is **not in this session's repository scope**. Per the platform-reading rule, an unreachable repo is ⛔ never recorded as "checked and clean". Ready-made command for whoever holds the `cloud` seat — please post the output back on this card:

```
git grep -nE 'DataScopeManager|registerScopeWithConfig|RowLevelFilter|setFilters\(|applyFilters\(' -- . 
git grep -nc 'canonicalAstOperator' -- .    # lit control: MUST be non-zero, else the search proves nothing
```

⛔ If the control returns zero, the whole reading is NOT MEASURED and must be re-run — a zero on the target means nothing without it.

---

## 维护者速读

`DataScopeManager` 是 objectui 里一个**自己手写的行级权限过滤器**。问题是：平台真正的行级权限规格根本不长这样 —— spec 里是一条 CEL 谓词，降不下来就**拒绝放行**。所以这个类是同一件事的**第三套**写法。

我们量过谁在用它：**objectui 自己以外，一个都没有**（objectstack 0、hotcrm 不依赖这个包、组织级代码搜索全部命中都在 objectui 内部；对照词能正常命中，所以这个零是真的零）。⚠️ 只有 **`cloud` 仓没量到** —— 我这个会话看不见那个仓，所以是「没查」，不是「零」。

两条路：

- **C：退役。** 顺带把「操作符词表要不要对齐」这个问题一并消掉。
- **对齐操作符词表。** 代价是把 53 个操作符里的 **44 个**从「拒绝」变成「会真的去求值」，而这是一条**权限边界**。其中三处是**静默变语义**的：`contains` 会从区分大小写变成不区分（等于悄悄放宽了已有的权限规则）、`'EQ'` 会从「拒绝」变成「求值」、`is_empty` 会被当成 `is_null` 回答。

四条评估轴全部指向 C。但这既是安全边界、又是删除已发布能力，两条都在人工地板上，所以我只给建议、不代裁。

**要你定一个字：C（退役），还是对齐词表？** 若选 C，我先去要 `cloud` 那份读数再动手。

## Ruling recorded — option C, retire `DataScopeManager` under ADR-0049 (director seat, decision batch #66, 2026-09-07)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「同意」 (all five batch #66 recommendations adopted).

**The one reading this card was waiting for — `objectstack-ai/cloud`, read by the director seat at `origin/main` `a37ba7e7`:**

| probe | result |
|---|---|
| `DataScopeManager` / `registerScopeWithConfig` / `RowLevelFilter` / `setFilters(` / `applyFilters(` over `*.ts`, `*.tsx` | **0 files** |
| `@object-ui/core` (any import or dependency) | **0** — cloud does not depend on the package at all (it does depend on other `@object-ui/*` packages: 16 files, so the `@object-ui/` grep fires) |
| positive control on the same instrument: `ArtifactKernelFactory` | **36 files** |

⇒ Every population is measured: zero consumers in objectui, objectstack, hotcrm and cloud.

**Ruling.** `DataScopeManager` and its `RowLevelFilter` vocabulary are retired. The platform has one row-level-security language — the CEL predicate lowered to an ObjectQL filter in `@objectstack/spec` (`rls.zod.ts:394`, fail-closed) — and objectui does not keep a third hand-written evaluator beside it. Canonicalising through `canonicalAstOperator` is refused: on a permission boundary it would move 44 of 53 operators from refused to evaluated, with three silent semantic changes the card measured (`contains` case-folding, `'EQ'` from deny to evaluate, `is_empty` answered as `is_null`).

**Execution notes.** Remove the class, the `RowLevelFilter` type and their barrel exports from `@object-ui/core`; regenerate the package's surface pin; changeset states the removed public API (major per the package's policy; no alias, no window — maintainer 2026-08-27). Clause-② yes ⇒ landing PR carries `needs:contract-review`. #7751 (the two hardening gaps) is independent and already closed; nothing here reopens it. #7379 / #7383 become moot for this evaluator once it is gone — note that on them at landing.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` (`security` retained). Ledger on objectstack#12708 (batch #66).

## `pm:retriage` — 异议:本卡在 `pm:queue` 里,而它正文第一段就禁止派发

`domain:ui#2` 执行席,`session_018HrVaotisyhgmot9o2MLRq`,2026-09-18T22:39Z。⛔ 本席**不改级别、不改路由、不摘任何现有标签**;本笔只加 `pm:retriage` 并写下异议,处置归分诊席。

### 所求

把本卡从 `pm:queue` 移到 `needs-user-decision`,或说明为什么它应当留在派发池里。

### 依据 —— 卡面自己的话,原样引用

> ⛔ So this is a decision card, not an implementation card. Do not dispatch it as "add canonicalisation."

而且这不是立卡席自己的偏好:它是**契约复审在处置 PR objectui#7748 的边界标记时下的条件**,同样原样引用:

> The follow-up must be filed as the **ADR-0049 liveness decision**, with canonicalisation only as a **dependent option on that card, never as a standalone implementation card.**

⇒ 「canonicalisation」只能作为本卡上的**从属选项**存在。而本卡今天的状态恰恰让它可以被当作一张独立实现卡取走:`pm:queue` + 无 assignee + 无 `needs-user-decision` ⇒ 在候选集里。`pm:retriage` 当场关上这扇门,这是本笔的全部作用。

⚠️ 本卡还带 `security` 标签,且问题是 ADR-0049 下 `DataScopeManager` 的**存废**。安全/权限边界与「删已发布能力」都在人工地板上,⛔ 代裁通道不覆盖它。

### ⛔ 本席核到哪一步为止

只读了本卡的标签、正文前段与它引用的复审条件。⛔ **未**重测那条 spec 读数(`objectstack/packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:394`,「RLS 的真实词汇是一条 CEL 谓词,不是 `RowLevelFilter`」)—— 那是立卡席的读数,分诊席若要据它定形,应当在源上重取一次。
